zh.title: Wave Tank：波浪水箱
zh.summary: 在三维水箱里制造波浪，看水流与沙滩球一起运动。
zh.action: 选择水流场景，拖动水或调整重力、黏度等参数。
zh.why: 轻盈的交互让流体模拟像一个可以随手试验的小玩具。
zh.limit: 画面表现依赖设备的图形能力，模拟结果仅供探索。

en.title: Wave Tank
en.summary: Make waves in a 3D tank and watch the water and beach ball move.
en.action: Choose a scene, drag the water, or adjust gravity and viscosity.
en.why: A playful interface makes fluid simulation inviting to explore.
en.limit: Performance depends on graphics hardware; the simulation is for exploration.

alt.zh: 透明水槽里有蓝色水流和沙滩球，右侧是模拟参数。
alt.en: Blue water and a beach ball in a transparent tank beside simulation controls.

verification.note: Grok Bot 报告在桌面浏览器观察到水体流动与球体运动；手机未核验。
verification.note_en: Grok Bot reported observing the water and ball move in a desktop browser; mobile was not tested.

zh.title: Heart and Blood：心脏与循环
zh.summary: 观察三维心脏剖面，跟随课程了解心脏和血液循环。
zh.action: 进入第一课，选择 Look inside 查看剖面，再点 Next 浏览下一部分。
zh.why: 课程把三维模型、文字和互动练习放在一起。
zh.limit: AI 创作方式尚未确认；仅测试第一课部分操作，其他课程和手机体验未测。

en.title: Heart and Blood
en.summary: Inspect a 3D heart cross-section and follow lessons on the heart and circulation.
en.action: Enter the first lesson, choose Look inside, then select Next to continue.
en.why: A 3D model, text and interactive exercises come together in one lesson.
en.limit: AI creation has not been confirmed; only part of the first lesson was tested. Other lessons and mobile are unverified.

verification.note: 本机桌面审核进入第一课、查看剖面并打开练习；其余课程、声音和手机未测。
verification.note_en: In a local desktop browser, the reviewer entered the first lesson, opened the cross-section and opened the exercise; other lessons, audio and mobile were not tested.

alt.zh: 心脏三维模型悬在血液循环示意图上方，右侧是课程说明。
alt.en: A 3D heart above a circulation diagram with a lesson panel alongside.

zh.title: WeduLab：VoltLab 电路实验台
zh.summary: 在 WeduLab 的电路实验台上连接元件，观察电压和电流。
zh.action: 打开实验后选择示例，点击 S1 开关，观察示波器读数变化。
zh.why: 电路与测量仪器放在同一工作台上，便于边动手边理解。
zh.limit: 这个具体实验的 AI 创作方式尚未确认；仅测试一个电路，手机体验未测。

en.title: WeduLab: VoltLab Circuit Lab
en.summary: Connect components and observe voltage and current at WeduLab’s circuit workbench.
en.action: Open an example and toggle switch S1 to observe the oscilloscope readings.
en.why: A circuit and its measuring instruments share one workbench for hands-on learning.
en.limit: AI creation of this specific lab has not been confirmed; one circuit was tested and mobile is unverified.

verification.note: 本机桌面审核在中文界面闭合 S1 并观察电流变化；英文入口可访问，手机未测。
verification.note_en: In a local desktop browser, the reviewer closed S1 in the Chinese interface and observed the current change; the English entry responded and mobile was not tested.
